title: Purification of RNA from a DNA/RNA Extract
author: Roey Angel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bftbjnin

steps.title: Prepare DNase digestion mixture
steps.instruction: Prepare the following mixture in a 1.5 ml tube, bringing the total volume to 50 µL with RNase-free water (Carl Roth #T143.1):

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL to 42 µL of TNA extract (containing 1 µg to 3 µg of DNA).
Add 10x TURBO DNase buffer.
Add RNaseOUT (Thermo Fisher #10777019).
Add 0.1M DTT (Thermo Fisher #707265ML).
Add TURBO DNase (Thermo Fisher #AM2238, 2 U/µL) up to 2 µg.

steps.title: Incubate mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare for RNA binding
steps.instruction: Add binding reagents to the digested mixture.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL Binding Buffer (GeneJET RNA Cleanup and Concentration Micro Kit, Thermo Fisher #K0841).
Add 300 µL absolute ethanol (Molecular Biology Grade, Thermo Fisher #BP2818500).

steps.title: Bind RNA to column
steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to a GeneJET RNA Purification Micro Column preassembled with a collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at 14,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Discard the flow-through and place the column back into the collection tube.

steps.title: Perform first wash
steps.instruction: Wash the column using Wash Buffer 1.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µL Wash Buffer 1 (supplemented with ethanol, GeneJET Kit #K0841) to the column.
Centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Discard the flow-through and place the column back into the collection tube.

steps.title: Perform second wash
steps.instruction: Wash the column using Wash Buffer 2.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µL Wash Buffer 2 (supplemented with ethanol, GeneJET Kit #K0841) to the column.
Centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Discard the flow-through and place the column back into the collection tube.

steps.title: Repeat second wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the Wash Buffer 2 step (adding 700 µL, centrifuging at 14,000 x g for 1 minute, and discarding flow-through).

steps.title: Remove residual wash buffer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the empty GeneJET RNA Purification Micro Column at 14,000 x g for 2 minutes at room temperature to completely remove residual ethanol.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA into a clean 1.5 ml collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the column into a clean 1.5 ml collection tube.
Add 10 µL to 20 µL of RNA storage solution (Thermo Fisher #AM7000) or nuclease-free water to the column.
Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 1 minute at room temperature to elute the RNA.

steps.title: Store or use RNA
steps.instruction: Discard the purification column and handle the purified RNA.

substeps.instruction: Use RNA immediately or store at -20 °C or -80 °C.
For storage longer than 1 month, -80 °C is recommended.
